dialogues.speaker: Zinat
dialogues.text: This subject is better discussed with colleagues in Kshahrewar.

dialogues.speaker: Zinat
dialogues.text: I can't divulge the specifics, but it's a viability study for outfitting constructs with a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Zinat
dialogues.text: I'm a Span{RUBY#[S]Elementalism}tamad researcher specializing in the flow of elemental energy. I don't know enough about powering constructs, so I'll need help.

dialogues.speaker: Zinat
dialogues.text: That's how academic research works. It's not something one can just power through alone.

dialogues.speaker: Zinat
dialogues.text: Few can be like Rifaet, who can do research alone and produce lots of results on top of that. Sometimes, it's necessary to work together.
